race.comment: The girls turn and it looks a race in two for ours. At the early prices and with the likely map we'll side with FRINGILLA (8) who smashed the clock leading all of the way at Geelong last start over 1765m. She can kick up to lead again here and will give a huge sight. MISS WAITITI (2) comes back to her own sex having beaten the boys in the Super Impose last start, well backed there. She'll relish 2000m but will need a touch of luck from a low gate and goes heavy to good. They look the two, although QUICK FINISH (4) has done nothing wrong, off a letup into last start and winning well here. This is tougher however. YOUR COLOUR (5) comes down from Sydney off a good run in the Dulcify Stakes, just not sure how big a start she gives them from the wide gate. ABAYA (13) can be excused from last time on heavy, she can run much better from barrier one at huge odds.
